name: ad-attack
title_zh: 拿到域账号后不再卡壳的 AD 全链路攻击手册
tagline_zh: 从 Kerberoast 到 ADCS ESC17，破解票据后接着用账号横向，ACL 滥用、中继、信任域一路打通。
tagline_en: From Kerberoast to ADCS ESC17, crack then use, relay, abuse ACLs, cross trusts—one continuous chain to own the.
desc_en: Active Directory exploitation after domain credentials exist: Kerberos (AS-REP/Kerberoast including cracking the ticket then using the account), delegation, NTLM coercion/relay, lateral movement, ACL abuse, ADCS ESC1-ESC17 and CVE paths, dMSA/BadSuccessor, Kerberos reflection, identity confusion, management-plane, domain trust, and domain persistence. Own the current AD chain through crack-and-use
why_zh: 不是零散 PoC 堆砌，而是按攻击链编排：每步产出直接喂给下一步，破解出的账号自动进入后续利用。
why_en: Not a PoC dump—it's chain-ordered: each step's output feeds the next, cracked accounts auto-flow into later moves, no.
limit_zh: 只覆盖拿到域凭据之后的攻击面；不碰初始打点、不提权到域管。需要目标域可达且你已有至少一个普通域账号。
limit_en: Post-credential only; no initial foothold or DA privesc. Requires network reachability and at least one valid domain account.
title_en: Post-credential AD attack playbook that never dead-ends
